property.description: the organization property (omit to list what is configurable, with value, risk and who may change it)

value.description: the new value as text (true, 42, ASYNC)

clear.description: true removes the organization's override so the default applies again

confirm.description: the property name again, required to apply a dangerous or unclassified property

match.description: list only: a substring of the name or description

apply.description: false (default) is a dry run; true makes the change

network_id.description: guarded window: the network of the snapshot to reprocess

reprocess_snapshot_id.description: guarded window: set the value, reprocess this one snapshot, wait, and always restore the original value

window_minutes.description: guarded window: how long it may last, also how far ahead collection schedules are checked (default 30, at most 240)
